name: SheetWriteAddressing.addressedCell(for:)
reason: one arm per place the addressing walk stops (Week, absent Day, repeated Day, column, Exercise, Last Set RPE, Set Log), each its own writer error or cell, with the Set Log outcomes already handed to the placement rule's own switch (#651); the repeated Day is its own arm so its refusal names the repeat, not a missing Day (#768)

name: SheetWritePlanner.addressing(for:in:)
reason: the planner's one addressing walk (Week, Day, column, Exercise, then the column's rule), each step a distinct refusal in the order SheetWriteAddressingTests pins; the target and the audit both read it, so splitting a step into a helper moves a branch without removing one (#651); an absent Day splits into repeated and missing so the refusal names the repeat (#768)

name: SheetWriterError.errorDescription.get
reason: nine cases, each its own message; collapsing the not-found cases would erase typed payloads the sync path matches on, a repeated Day header must not read as a missing one (#768), and the Day-headers refusal (#749) names no Day because either numbering would send the athlete to another Session

name: SheetWritePlanner.rowScanDetails(for:selectedRow:in:)
reason: narrates each place the addressing walk stops, one arm per SheetWriteAddressing case, so the audit names the same reason the refusal does; the repeated Day (#768) is the arm that took it over the threshold, and folding it into the not-found arm would narrate a missing Day while the Sheet shows it twice

name: SyncCoordinator.flushPendingWrites(_:context:)
reason: five distinct decisions (skip, batch failure, conflict, unexpected error, final batch); the only duplicate pair cannot merge without an unreachable exhaustive catch

name: SyncNowDetail.text(outcome:isSyncing:hasSheet:)
